-- Monthly spend per model, most expensive first.
WITH usage AS (
    SELECT
        date_trunc('month', created_at) AS month,
        model_id,
        SUM(prompt_tokens)     AS prompt_tokens,
        SUM(completion_tokens) AS completion_tokens
    FROM api_requests
    WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '6 months'
      AND status = 'succeeded'
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT
    u.month,
    u.model_id,
    ROUND((u.prompt_tokens * p.input_per_million
         + u.completion_tokens * p.output_per_million) / 1e6, 2) AS usd
FROM usage u
JOIN model_prices p USING (model_id)
ORDER BY u.month DESC, usd DESC;
